title: Mixed Conditionals / Ibyo Byaba Kuri Kondisionali Zikoranyijwe
bridge: Mu ikinyarwanda, ibyo byaba kuri kondisionali zikoranyijwe ntibifite umubare wabo: tubikoresha ububiko bw’imizi zigenderanya buri rimwe kandi buri rimwe kugira ngo bishobore kushyiraho iby’ubushakashatsi n’iby’ubushakashatsi. Mu Icyongereza, ububiko bwa kondisionali zikoranyijwe bubanjirijwe mu buryo butandukanye: ubwoko bw’ibyo byaba (if-clause) na bw’ibyo byaba (main clause) bikoresha imizi zigenderanya zikoranyijwe zifite ububiko butandukanye buri rimwe kandi buri rimwe. Ubwoko bw’ibyo byaba (if-clause) na bw’ibyo byaba (main clause) bikoresha imizi zigenderanya zikoranyijwe zifite ububiko butandukanye buri rimwe kandi buri rimwe.
rule: Ibyo byaba kuri kondisionali zikoranyijwe bikoranya ubushakashatsi mu kasha n’ubushakashatsi mu kasha (ubwoko 3 + ubwoko 2) cyangwa ubushakashatsi mu kasha n’ubushakashatsi mu kasha (ubwoko 2 + ubwoko 3). Ububiko 1: If + past perfect, would + base verb (ubushakashatsi mu kasha, ubushakashatsi mu kasha). Inyuze: If I had studied harder, I would have a better job now. Ububiko 2: If + simple past, would have + past participle (ubushakashatsi mu kasha, ubushakashatsi mu kasha). Inyuze: If I were you, I would have told her the truth. Ibikorwa ndangamuntu: Mu byo byaba kuri kondisionali zikoranyijwe, ni byaba kugirana 'were' mu buryo buri rimwe kandi buri rimwe mu gihe ubushakashatsi mu kasha (If I were...). Nanone, ububiko bw’ibyaba na bw’ibyaba bigaragara mu buryo butandukanye buri rimwe kandi buri rimwe, ariko ubwoko bw’ibyaba bukoreshwa mu gihe ubushakashatsi mu kasha. Ubukoresho bw’ibikorwa: kushyiraho ubwoba, iby’ubushakashatsi, iby’ubushakashatsi kuri ibintu by’ubushakashatsi bifite ubushakashatsi mu kasha cyangwa mu kasha.

concept_examples.text: If I had studied more, I would be more confident now.
concept_examples.translation: Nija mbaziriye neza, niba naba njye njye.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪf aɪ hæd ˈstʌdid mɔːr, aɪ wʊd biː mɔːr ˈkɑːnfɪdənt naʊ/

concept_examples.text: If she were more organized, she would have finished the project yesterday.
concept_examples.translation: Niba yaba yaba yaba, yaba yaba yaba.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪf ʃiː wɜːr mɔːr ˈɔːrɡənaɪzd, ʃiː wʊd hæv ˈfɪnɪʃt ðə ˈprɒdʒekt ˈjestərdeɪ/

concept_examples.text: If I hadn't missed the flight, I wouldn't be stuck in this hotel.
concept_examples.translation: Niba ntabwo nabonye, nta niba njye njye.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪf aɪ ˈhædənt mɪst ðə flaɪt, aɪ ˈwʊdənt biː stʌk ɪn ðɪs hoʊˈtel/

concept_examples.text: If he were here, he would have solved the problem easily.
concept_examples.translation: Niba yaba yaba, yaba yaba yaba.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪf hiː wɜːr hɪr, hiː wʊd hæv sɑːlvd ðə ˈprɑːbləm ˈiːzəli/

common_error.wrong: If I would have known, I would have told you.
common_error.correct: If I had known, I would have told you.
common_error.correct_alt: Had I known, I would have told you.
common_error.explanation: Iyi ni ibyishimo byinshi kuri abanyarwanda kubera mu kinyarwanda biravuga 'Nija mbaziriye', ariko mu Icyongereza ubushakashatsi ntibukoresha 'would' buri rimwe kandi buri rimwe. Mu byo byaba (if-clause) bikoresha 'past perfect' bizagira 'would'. Kugira ngo ubishyire, remera 'would' bukomeye mu byo byaba (ubushakashatsi). Nanone, ubishyire ububiko bw’ibyo byaba bizagira 'if' bikoranya imizi zigenderanya: 'Had I known...'.

levels.label: Mixed Conditional Type 1: Past Condition, Present Result
levels.translation: Ibyo Byaba Kuri Kondisionali Zikoranyijwe Ubwoko 1: Ubushakashatsi mu Kasha, Ubushakashatsi mu Kasha

examples.original: If I had taken that job, I would be living in Madrid now.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf aɪ hæd ˈteɪkən ðæt dʒɒb, aɪ wʊd biː ˈlɪvɪŋ ɪn məˈdrɪd naʊ/
examples.translation: Nija mbaziriye, niba naba njye njye.
examples.note: Ubushakashatsi mu kasha (had taken) na ubushakashatsi mu kasha (would be living). Mu kinyarwanda bikoresha ubushakashatsi mu kasha mu byo byaba na mu byo byaba.

examples.original: If we hadn't argued, we would still be friends.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf wiː ˈhædənt ˈɑːrɡjuːd, wiː wʊd stɪl biː frendz/
examples.translation: Niba ntabwo twabanye, tubara tubara.
examples.note: Ubukoresho bw’ubushakashatsi 'still' (tubara) ni byaba kuri ubwoko bw’ibyaba kuri kondisionali zikoranyijwe kugira ngo bishyireho ubushakashatsi bukomeye mu kasha.

levels.label: Mixed Conditional Type 2: Present Condition, Past Result
levels.translation: Ibyo Byaba Kuri Kondisionali Zikoranyijwe Ubwoko 2: Ubushakashatsi mu Kasha, Ubushakashatsi mu Kasha

examples.original: If I were more careful, I wouldn't have made that mistake.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf aɪ wɜːr mɔːr ˈkerfəl, aɪ ˈwʊdənt hæv meɪd ðæt mɪˈsteɪk/
examples.translation: Niba njye njye, nta niba njye njye.
examples.note: Ubushakashatsi mu kasha (if I were) na ubushakashatsi mu kasha (wouldn't have made). Remera 'were' bikoreshwa mu buri rimwe kandi buri rimwe mu byo byaba, naho ari ubukoresho bw’ubushakashatsi.

examples.original: If she spoke English better, she would have understood the movie.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf ʃiː spoʊk ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ˈbetər, ʃiː wʊd hæv ˌʌndərˈstʊd ðə ˈmuːvi/
examples.translation: Niba yaba yaba, yaba yaba yaba.
examples.note: Bikoresha 'if + simple past' mu byo byaba (ubushakashatsi mu kasha) na 'would have + past participle' mu byo byaba (ubushakashatsi mu kasha). Mu kinyarwanda, imizi zigenderanya ziri mu byo byaba na mu byo byaba.

levels.label: Inverted and Reduced Mixed Conditionals
levels.translation: Ibyo Byaba Kuri Kondisionali Zikoranyijwe Zikoranyijwe na Zikoranyijwe

examples.original: Had I known about the meeting, I would be there now.
examples.phonetic: /hæd aɪ noʊn əˈbaʊt ðə ˈmiːtɪŋ, aɪ wʊd biː ðer naʊ/
examples.translation: Nija mbaziriye, niba naba njye njye.
examples.note: Ububiko bw’ibyo byaba bizagira 'if' ni byo byaba kuri ubushakashatsi mu kasha na ubushakashatsi mu kasha.

examples.original: Were I in your position, I would have accepted the offer.
examples.phonetic: /wɜːr aɪ ɪn jɔːr pəˈzɪʃən, aɪ wʊd hæv əkˈseptɪd ði ˈɒfər/
examples.translation: Niba njye njye, niba naba njye njye.
examples.note: Ububiko bw’ibyo byaba 'Were I...' ni ubwoko bw’ibyo byaba 'If I were...' na bukoreshwa kuri ubushakashatsi mu kasha. Ububiko bwa kondisionali zikoranyijwe ni ubwoko bw’ibyo byaba 'Had I...'.

examples.original: If you hadn't lied, we would trust you now.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf juː ˈhædənt laɪd, wiː wʊd trʌst juː naʊ/
examples.translation: Niba ntabwo wabanye, nta niba njye njye.
examples.note: Iyi ni inyuze y’ubukoresho bw’ibyo byaba: kugena iby’ubushakashatsi bifite ubushakashatsi mu kasha. Ubushakashatsi 'trust' mu byo byaba ni byo byaba kuri ubushakashatsi mu kasha.

title: Advanced Passive Voice: Gerunds, Infinitives, and Modals / Inyinguza y’umwimerere wa kihagije: Igerundi, Infinitives, na Modals
bridge: Mu igifaransa, umwimerere wa kihagije ubanzirizwa n’uburyo bukwiye ‘ser + participio’ kandi burarwa kugirwa n’amabwiriza y’umwimerere (gerundio/infinitivo). Mu Icyongereza, umwimerere wa kihagije ari akwiye kugeza: ubona ‘must be done’, ‘being done’, ‘to be done’, cyangwa ikindi. Ikibazo k’umwanya ni guhamya uburyo bwa gihugu cy’igifaransa kandi, nk’uko ‘debe ser hecho’ aho kuba ‘has to be done’. Nanone, mu Icyongereza umuntu wakoze ibikorwa ararirwa (ntubwira ‘by someone’ nibwo atari witegekeye), mu gihugu cy’igifaransa dusaba guhitamo.
rule: Mu Icyongereza, umwimerere wa kihagije w’amabwiriza y’umwimerere ubanzirizwa n’amabwiriza ‘to be’ mu biro by’imyaka, amabwiriza y’umwimerere cyangwa amabwiriza y’umwimerere atari yo kw’umuntu, yubakwa n’uburyo bwa kihagije bwa kurema. Kuri amabwiriza y’umwimerere: modal + be + participio (e.j. ‘must be done’, ‘can be seen’). Kuri infinitivos: to be + participio (e.j. ‘to be considered’). Kuri gerundios: being + participio (e.j. ‘being watched’). N’amabwiriza y’umwimerere y’amabwiriza y’umwimerere: modal + have been + participio (e.j. ‘should have been informed’). Nanone harimo amabwiriza y’umwimerere y’amabwiriza y’umwimerere: ‘This chair was sat on’ (niba ubwo butari bwitegekeye). Kwigomeka n’amabwiriza atari y’umwimerere (intransitivos) kandi n’uburyo bwa kurema bwa kurema: nibwo atari witegekeye, ararirwa.

concept_examples.text: The report must be submitted by Friday.
concept_examples.translation: Raporo yagombaga guhabwa kurushaho kw’isabunzu.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðə rɪˈpɔːrt mʌst biː səbˈmɪtɪd baɪ ˈfraɪdeɪ/

concept_examples.text: She enjoys being photographed.

concept_examples.phonetic: /ʃiː ɪnˈdʒɔɪz ˈbiːɪŋ ˈfoʊtəɡræft/

concept_examples.text: The problem needs to be solved immediately.
concept_examples.translation: Ibikorwa byagombaga gukingirwa hasi.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈprɑːbləm niːdz tə biː sɒlvd ɪˈmiːdiətli/

concept_examples.translation: Ibisabwa byagombye kuba byagenwe nyuma.

common_error.wrong: The problem must be solved *by us* immediately. (cuando no es necesario el agente)
common_error.correct: The problem must be solved immediately.
common_error.correct_alt: The problem has to be solved immediately.
common_error.explanation: Abanyarwanda bashobora kwinjira mu kandi ‘by someone’ kubera ko mu igifaransa bashobora kwinjira ‘por nosotros’ cyangwa ‘por alguien’. Mu Icyongereza, nibwo umuntu wakoze ibikorwa ari witegekeye cyangwa atari witegekeye, ararirwa kugira ngo uburyo bwa kurema bube bwitegekeye. Ikindi kandi ni ‘has to be solved’, ubwo ni uburyo bwa kurema bwa kurema. Nta n’uburyo bwa kurema bwa kurema.

levels.label: Passive with Modals
levels.translation: Umwimerere wa kihagije n’amabwiriza y’umwimerere

examples.original: The rules can be changed.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ruːlz kæn biː tʃeɪndʒd/
examples.translation: Imirimo yagombye guhindurwa.
examples.note: Shyiramo ‘can be’ kugira ngo uburyo bwa kurema bube bwitegekeye. Mu igifaransa, bashobora kwinjira ‘se pueden cambiar’.

examples.original: The application must be completed before noon.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˌæplɪˈkeɪʃən mʌst biː kəmˈpliːtɪd bɪˈfɔːr nuːn/
examples.translation: Inyandiko yagombye kugenzwa mbere y’ijoro.
examples.note: ‘Must be’ bishobora kugira ico gituma. Mu igifaransa, bashobora kwinjira ‘debe + infinitivo’.

examples.original: This issue should be addressed immediately.
examples.phonetic: /ðɪs ˈɪʃuː ʃʊd biː əˈdrest ɪˈmiːdiətli/
examples.translation: Ibikorwa byagombye gukingirwa hasi.
examples.note: ‘Should be’ kugira ngo uburyo bwa kurema bube bwitegekeye. Kwigomeka n’uburyo bwa kurema bwa kurema ‘should’.

examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈmiːtɪŋ meɪ biː poʊstˈpoʊnd ɪf ˈnesəseri/
examples.translation: Ubucuruzi bugombye gushyirwa mu kandi nibwo byagombye.
examples.note: ‘May be’ kugira ngo uburyo bwa kurema bube bwitegekeye. Mu igifaransa, bashobora kwinjira ‘puede ser’.

levels.label: Passive Gerunds and Infinitives
levels.translation: Igerundi n’Infinitivos z’umwimerere wa kihagije

examples.original: He dislikes being told what to do.

examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈdeɪtə niːdz tə biː ˈænəlaɪzd ˈkerfəli/

examples.note: Igerundi z’umwimerere ‘being involved’ zishimiye ‘estar implicado’ mu igifaransa.

levels.label: Passive with Perfect Modals and Reporting Verbs
levels.translation: Umwimerere wa kihagije n’amabwiriza y’umwimerere n’amabwiriza y’umwimerere

examples.original: The thief might have been caught by the police.
examples.phonetic: /ðə θiːf maɪt hæv biːn kɔːt baɪ ðə pəˈliːs/
examples.translation: Umukandida w’umwimerere wari witegekeye kuba yagenwe n’abantu b’umwimerere.
examples.note: Shyiramo ‘might have been’ kugira ngo uburyo bwa kurema bube bwitegekeye. Mu igifaransa: ‘podría haber sido’.

examples.original: The documents should have been signed yesterday.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈdɒkjumənts ʃʊd hæv biːn saɪnd ˈjestərdeɪ/
examples.translation: Inyandiko yari yagombye kugenzwa nyuma.
examples.note: Bishobora kugira ico gituma kuri ibikorwa by’umwimerere by’ubushake by’ubushake. Mu igifaransa: ‘deberían haber sido’.

examples.original: The president is said to be considering new policies.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈprezɪdənt ɪz sed tə biː kənˈsɪdərɪŋ nuː ˈpɒləsiz/
examples.translation: Byavuze ko umukandida w’umwimerere yari yitegekeye kugira ibikorwa by’umwimerere.
examples.note: Uburyo bwa kurema bwa kurema n’uburyo bwa kurema ‘is said to be’ + gerundio. Mu igifaransa bashobora kwinjira ‘se dice que’.

examples.original: The lost city is believed to have been discovered in 2015.
examples.phonetic: /ðə lɒst ˈsɪti ɪz bɪˈliːvd tə hæv biːn dɪˈskʌvərd ɪn tuː ˈθaʊzənd ənd fɪfˈtiːn/
examples.translation: Byemeye ko umujyi w’umwimerere wari wagenwe mu 2015.
examples.note: Umwimerere wa kihagije n’uburyo bwa kurema ‘be believed to + have been + participio’ kugira ngo uburyo bwa kurema bube bwitegekeye.

title: Advanced Reported Speech / Uburanani bw'ibinyacumuzi
bridge: Mu gihugu, igihe tubora ku buryanani bw'ibinyacumuzi, tubura igihe cy'umwanya w'inyandiko yibanze niba amatsinda y'inyandiko ari mu bushake, ariko mu gishanga, ni byo kugwa mu 'backshift' (gutubutsa igihe) niba amatsinda y'inyandiko ari mu bushake: 'She says she is tired' vs. 'She said she was tired'. Nanone, mu gishanga, ibyago by'igihe birimo bitangira kuri kintu kimwe: 'will' bihinduka 'would', 'can' bihinduka 'could', n'ibyago by'ibyo bitanze birimo bitangira kuri kintu kimwe (past simple → past perfect). Ikindi kiganira kinini ni uko mu gishanga ntibitondetse amatsinda y'inyandiko nk'umu gihugu ('Dijo que viniera' → 'He said to come' cyangwa 'He said that I should come'), n'uko amatsinda y'igihe n'ahantu birimo bitangira kuri kintu kimwe (today → that day, here → there).
rule:
Kuri uburanani bw'ibinyacumuzi bw'ibinyacumuzi mu gishanga (umubare w'ibinyacumuzi B2):
1. **Backshift (gutubutsa igihe)**: Niba amatsinda y'inyandiko ari mu bushake (said, told, asked), igihe cy'umwanya w'inyandiko mu buryanani bw'ibinyacumuzi birimo bitangira kuri kintu kimwe: present simple → past simple; present continuous → past continuous; past simple → past perfect; present perfect → past perfect; will → would; can → could; may → might; must → had to (cyangwa must niba ni ububasha bw'ubwenge).
2. **Nta backshift**: Nta gutubutsa igihe kidashoboye kugwa niba igisubizo kirimo kiraremenye cyangwa kirimo ubwenge mu gihe cy'kwambara (naho ni ikintu gishobora gusohoza): 'He said he is ill' (yigiye kuba arwaye) cyangwa 'He said he was ill' (ntibishoboye gutangira).
3. **Ibyago by'amatsinda n'ibyago by'ubwoko**: Gutunganya kuri ubwoko bw'ubwenge: 'I' → 'he/she', 'my' → 'his/her', adi.
4. **Ibyago by'amatsinda y'igihe n'ahantu**: today → that day; yesterday → the day before / the previous day; tomorrow → the next day / the following day; here → there; now → then.
5. **Ibibazo mu buryanani bw'ibinyacumuzi**: Uburanani bw'ibibazo burimo bitangira kuri kintu kimwe n'amatsinda 'if/whether' kuri ebyo, n'ijambo ry'ibibazo kuri ibibazo by'ubwenge. Nta kugirwa amatsinda 'do/does/did': 'Where does he live?' → 'She asked where he lived.'
6. **Amabwiriza n'ibyo bashakisha**: Harimo 'tell/ask + ikintu + infinitivo': 'He told me to close the door.' Nta kugirwa 'that'.
7. **Amatsinda y'ubwenge**: 'would', 'could', 'might', 'should', 'ought to' ntibihinduka. 'must' bishobora kubura cyangwa kuhinduka 'had to' kuri ubwoko bw'ubwenge.

concept_examples.text: She said she had finished the report the day before.
concept_examples.translation: Yabwiye yako yari yatanziye urwego rw'inyandiko rw'izuba ryashize.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ʃiː sed ʃiː hæd ˈfɪnɪʃt ðə rɪˈpɔːrt ðə deɪ bɪˈfɔːr/

concept_examples.text: He asked if I could help him with the project.
concept_examples.translation: Yabazuze yaba ashobora kumubera ubufasha mu gacuruzi.
concept_examples.phonetic: /hiː æskt ɪf aɪ kʊd hɛlp hɪm wɪð ðə ˈprɒdʒɛkt/

concept_examples.text: They told us to wait outside.
concept_examples.translation: Twabwirwemo tugumane hafi.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðeɪ toʊld ʌs tə weɪt ˌaʊtˈsaɪd/

concept_examples.text: She warned that the meeting might be postponed.
concept_examples.translation: Yatanze yuko uburanani bworoshye bushobora kubura.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ʃiː wɔːrnd ðæt ðə ˈmiːtɪŋ maɪt biː poʊstˈpoʊnd/

common_error.wrong: She said me that she was tired.
common_error.correct: She told me that she was tired.
common_error.correct_alt: She said that she was tired.
common_error.explanation: Mu gihugu, 'decir' bitondetse ikintu cy'ubwenge (me dijo), ariko mu gishanga 'say' ntabwo bitondetse ikintu cy'ubwenge; harimo 'tell' igihe ubishura uzabwiye nde. Kubera iyo mpamvu, 'said me' si byo kuri; wemera 'told me' cyangwa 'said' nta kugirwa ikintu.

levels.label: Statements with Backshift
levels.translation: Igisubizo cy'ubwenge n'ubwoko bw'ubwenge

examples.original: Paul said he was going to London the following day.
examples.phonetic: /pɔːl sɛd hiː wɒz ˈɡəʊɪŋ tə ˈlʌndən ðə ˈfɒləʊɪŋ deɪ/
examples.translation: Paul yabwiye yuko yari agenda mu London kuri izuba ryashize.
examples.note: Reeba ubwoko bw'ubwenge: 'is going' → 'was going' na 'tomorrow' → 'the following day'.

examples.original: She mentioned she had already seen that film.
examples.phonetic: /ʃiː ˈmɛnʃənd ʃiː hæd ɔːlˈrɛdi siːn ðæt fɪlm/
examples.translation: Yabwiye yuko yari yabonye iyo sinema.
examples.note: Igihe cy'ubwenge 'have seen' birimo bitangira kuri kintu kimwe 'had seen'.

examples.original: They claimed they would finish the project by Friday.
examples.phonetic: /ðeɪ kleɪmd ðeɪ wʊd ˈfɪnɪʃ ðə ˈprɒdʒɛkt baɪ ˈfraɪdeɪ/
examples.translation: Baravuze yuko bazakomereza igacuruzi kuri munsi w'inshuro ya mbere.
examples.note: 'Will' bihinduka 'would' mu buryanani bw'ibinyacumuzi.

levels.label: Reported Questions
levels.translation: Ibibazo mu buryanani bw'ibinyacumuzi

examples.original: She asked where the nearest bank was.

title: Inversion for Emphasis / Inyandikorwa zo kugira ubushake
bridge: Mu gihingirishya, kugira ubushake, tubyara tubikorera umutwe w’inyanja cyangwa guhindura ubwoko bw’amagambo n’ubwoko bw’ubushake ("Nta n’iki nk’ibyo narabonye"). Mu gishushimane, rero, igihe amagambo akomeye cyangwe akomeye (rarely, not only, never, adi.) ashishirwa ku mwishipuro, ni bindimo kugira ubwoko bw’umuntu n’ubwoko bw’umuntu (cyangwa igisubizo 'to be'), nk’ubwoko bw’ibibazo. Ubu bwoko bw’ubushake ntibuhagije: n’ubwo utabyishyura, igisubizo kirimo ubushake ari bwo butandukanye n’ubwoko bw’ubushake mu gishushimane. Ibibazo by’ubushake by’umuntu ni ukubura ubwoko bw’ubushake kubera ko mu gihingirishya nta bwoko bw’ubushake.
rule: Inyandikorwa zo kugira ubushake zifashwa igihe igisubizo cyangwa igisubizo kirimo ubushake cyangwa kigenzura gishishirwa ku mwishipuro. Ibigenzura by’ubushake ni: never, rarely, seldom, hardly ever, not only, no sooner, little, under no circumstances, at no time, in no way. Ubwoko bw’ubushake ni: [Igisubizo cyangwe kigenzura kirimo ubushake] + igisubizo (do/does/did, have/has, will, can, adi.) + umuntu + igisubizo kihambaye. N’ubwo nta gisubizo, ‘do’ ni kuva mu kasha cyangwa ‘did’ ni kuva mu kasha (usibye na ‘to be’, igishishwa direct). Na ‘not only’ ubwoko bw’ubushake bwigishwa mu kwanuka kwanuka: "Not only did she sing, but she also danced". Na ‘no sooner’ ubwoko bw’ubushake bwigishwa mu kasha k’ubushake: "No sooner had we arrived than it started raining". Ubu bwoko bw’ubushake ni bwo butandukanye n’ubwoko bw’ubushake cyangwa bw’ubushake, ariko bigishwa mu mico y’ubushake n’ubushake.

common_error.wrong: Rarely we see such beautiful sunsets.

common_error.correct_alt: We rarely see such beautiful sunsets.
common_error.explanation: Ibibazo bifite ubwoko bw’ubushake kubera ko mu gihingirishya "Igihe kinini nta dusanga..." bigishwa n’ubwoko bw’ubushake, n’umwana w’ishushimane yishyura mu buryo bw’ubushake. Mu gishushimane, igihe igisubizo cyangwe kigenzura kirimo ubushake kishishirwa ku mwishipuro, ni bindimo kugira ubwoko bw’ubushake n’ubwoko bw’ubushake ‘do’ (mu kasha). Inyungu y’ubwoko bw’ubushake ni kushyiramo igisubizo cyangwe kigenzura kirimo ubushake hadi mu mwishipuro ("We rarely see..."), ubu ni ubwoko bw’ubushake bw’ubushake mu mutwe. Kugira ngo ubwiye ibibazo, remera: n’ubwo igisubizo cyangwe kigenzura kirimo ubushake kishishirwa ku mwishipuro, wabwirwa kugira ubwoko bw’ubushake; n’ubwo ntushaka kugira ubwoko bw’ubushake, kugira ubwoko bw’ubushake mu buryo bw’ubushake.

levels.translation: Inyandikorwa zo kugira ubushake z’amagambo akomeye

examples.original: Never have I been so happy.

levels.label: Inversion with 'Not Only' and 'No Sooner'
levels.translation: Inyandikorwa zo kugira ubushake na 'Not Only' na 'No Sooner'

examples.original: Not only did they win the match, but they also broke the record.

examples.original: Not only is she intelligent, but she is also very creative.

levels.translation: Inyandikorwa zo kugira ubushake z’amagambo akomeye akomeye

examples.note: Kandi bigishwa na amagambo akomeye nk’ ‘can’, ‘could’, ‘should’. Ubwoko bw’ubushake bwigishwa n’ubwoko bw’ubushake.

title: Cleft sentences (It is/was... that) / Ibyahinduwe by’ubusa
bridge: Mu gaciri, kugira ngo dufise ubushake ahantu hagati, tukoresha ibyakozwe nka ‘Fue Juan quien lo hizo’ cyangwa ‘Es aquí donde vivo’. Mu Icyongereza, bikozwe na ‘it’ + ‘to be’ + ibintu by’ubushake + ‘that/who’ + ikintu gishize. Ububabare buhagije buvuga ko mu Icyongereza, ijambo ‘it’ ni bihombe (ntirashobora kugafata), na ‘that’ rushobora kuganzwa na ‘who’ mu buryo bw’abantu, ariko ‘which’ atari igishobora gufatwa mu bihe by’ubusa. Nanone, uburyo bwo kushyira amagambo ni bishushanyije kurusha mu gaciri, aho ubu buryo bwo kushyira amagambo bworoshye kuruta.
rule: Ibyahinduwe by’ubusa byerekana ubushake ahantu hagati mu mwijima. Uburyo bw’ibikozwe ni: ‘It’ + ‘to be’ (mu buri gihe cyangwa mu kawa) + ibintu by’ubushake (umuntu, ikintu, igihe, ahantu, n.a) + ijambo ry’ububiko (‘that’, ‘who’, ‘whom’, ‘whose’) + ikintu gishize. Ku by’abantu, ‘who’ (umuntu) cyangwa ‘whom’ (ikintu, nyamara mu buryo bw’ubwoko). Ku by’ikintu n’ibindi, ‘that’ (cyangwa ‘which’ mu buryo bw’ubwoko). Mu buri gihe, ‘is’ ni igishoboka, mu kawa ‘was’. ‘It’s’ atari igishoboka mu kawa (ntibiri mu buryo bw’ubwoko), ‘it was’ ni igishoboka. Ibintu by’ubushake birashobora kuba ijambo, ijambo ry’ububiko, cyangwa igisubizo. Inyuze: ‘It was Maria who called me.’ / ‘It is the weekend that I enjoy the most.’ / ‘It was in Paris that we met.’ / ‘It is because of you that I came.’ Nanone, harimo ibikozwe nka ‘what’ (what-clauses): ‘What I need is a coffee.’ Mu bihe by’ubusa, ‘what’ ni igishoboka ku mwishura, ‘it’ atari igishoboka. Ibikozwe nka ‘The reason why...’, ‘The thing that...’, ‘The person who...’, ariko iby’ubushake n’iby’ubwoko ni iby’ubushake. Ibikorwa: ‘it’ atari igishoboka mu buryo bw’ubushake (bikoreshwa ibikozwe nka ‘what...do’). Mu gakenera, ‘It wasn’t...’ cyangwa ‘It isn’t...’ ni iby’ubushake.

common_error.wrong: Fue Juan que rompió la ventana.
common_error.correct: It was John who broke the window.
common_error.correct_alt: It was John that broke the window.
common_error.explanation: Ububabare buhagije ni guhindura mu buryo bw’ubwoko ‘Fue Juan que...’ kandi gufata ‘it’ mu Icyongereza. Mu Icyongereza, uburyo bw’ibikozwe ni ‘it’ ku mwishura. Nanone, mu gaciri, ‘que’ ni igishoboka ku by’abantu n’ibintu, ariko mu Icyongereza, ‘who’ ni igishoboka ku by’abantu (ariko ‘that’ ni igishoboka, ‘who’ ni by’ubushake). Nanone, ‘to be’ ni igishoboka mu buri gihe n’umuntu: ‘is’ mu buri gihe, ‘was’ mu kawa, ‘was’ atari igishoboka na ‘it’ mu buri gihe (ntibiri mu buryo bw’ubwoko: ‘It is was’). Kugira ngo ubishyire mu buryo bw’ubwoko, kora ibyakozwe na ‘it’ + ‘be’ + ibintu by’ubushake + ‘who/that’.

title: Nominalisation: Turning Verbs and Adjectives into Nouns / Gutegura amabwiriza n’ibiryayo kugira ngo ubane ibiranga
bridge: Mu gihugu cy’Angilere, gutegura amabwiriza n’ibiryayo kugira ngo ubane ibiranga ni ikintu kinini cy’ubwoko bw’inyandiko z’akademi: ‘the discovery of’ ni ukubiri kurushaho ‘they discovered’. Ahubwo k’Ubuspanieri, aho bikorwa ibiranga nka ‘el descubrir’, mu gihugu cy’Angilere bikorwa ibiranga nka -tion, -ment, -ness. Kanga ubwoba: ntamabwiriza yose afite ubiranga buvanye n’ubwoko bwawe, kandi uburyo bwo kushyira amagambo bugaruka: mu gihugu cy’Angilere, ijambo ryo kumenya (or 'of') rigiye igihe kiragezwa n’ikiranga, mu gihugu cy’Ubuspanieri bikorwa ‘de’ nyuma y’ikiranga.
rule:
Kuri B2, gukora ibintu bibi:
1. Amabwiriza → ibiranga n’ibiryayo: -tion (inform → information), -ment (develop → development), -ance/-ence (perform → performance), -al (approve → approval), -ure (fail → failure).
2. Ibiriya → ibiranga: -ness (happy → happiness), -ity (active → activity), -th (strong → strength), -ce (important → importance).
3. Amabwiriza y’uburyo bw’ikinyoma: choose → choice, believe → belief, prove → proof, lose → loss.
4. Gutumika: mu gihugu cy’Angilere cy’ubwoko bw’inyandiko z’akademi bikorwa ‘the implementation of the plan’ ahubwo ‘they implemented the plan’. N’ijambo ‘make’ + ubiranga: ‘make a decision’ ahubwo ‘decide’.
5. Ibintu bikorwa: amabwiriza yimwe ntibigaruka (change → change), n’ibiranga bimwe bifite uburyo bw’ikinyoma (relation vs. relationship).

concept_examples.translation: Dushaka igituma kuri mbere y’ejo.
concept_examples.phonetic: /wiː niːd ə dɪˈsɪʒən baɪ təˈmɒroʊ/

common_error.wrong: The discovery of the new planet was made by NASA.
common_error.correct: The discovery of the new planet was made by NASA.
common_error.explanation: Uyu mbonera ni ukuri; mu by’ukuri, ikibazo gihuye ni gukoresha ubwoko bw’ubwoko ahubwo ubiranga: 'They discovered the new planet' mu buryo bw’ubwoko bw’inyandiko z’akademi ahubwo 'The discovery of the new planet...'. Abanyarwanda bashobora kugira ubwoba bwo gutumiza ‘el descubrir’ cyangwa gutumiza ubwoko bw’ubwoko nka ‘The discovering of...’ ubu ni ikibazo. Kugira ngo ubihindure, jya ubone ibiryayo by’ubiranga kandi ukorane kugira ngo ubirenze amabwiriza y’ubwoko bw’ubwoko.

levels.label: Verb to Noun Suffixes
levels.translation: Ibiryayo by’ubwoko bw’ubwoko

examples.original: The invention of the internet changed communication.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ɪnˈvɛnʃən əv ði ˈɪntəˌnɛt tʃeɪndʒd kəˌmjuːnɪˈkeɪʃən/
examples.translation: Gutegura ubwenge bw’ubuki bw’ubuki byagezeho ubwiza bw’ubuki bw’ubuki.
examples.note: Ubwoko bw’ubwoko -tion bugarura 'invent' kuri 'invention'. Mu gihugu cy’Ubuspanieri nuka -ción, ariko kanga ubwoba n’uburyo bwo kushyira amagambo.

examples.original: His improvement in English was remarkable.
examples.phonetic: /hɪz ɪmˈpruːvmənt ɪn ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ wɒz rɪˈmɑːrkəbl/
examples.translation: Ubwiza bwe bwari buzuye kuri buri wese.
examples.note: Ubwoko bw’ubwoko -ment: improve → improvement. Mu gihugu cy’Ubuspanieri bikorwa ‘mejora’ ahubwo ubwoko bw’ubwoko.

examples.original: The appearance of the actor caused excitement.
examples.phonetic: /ði əˈpɪərəns əv ði ˈæktər kɔːzd ɪkˈsaɪtmənt/
examples.translation: Gutegura ubwenge bw’ubuki bw’ubuki byagezeho ubwiza bw’ubuki bw’ubuki.
examples.note: Ubwoko bw’ubwoko -ance: appear → appearance. Ntukagire ‘apparition’ (fantasma).

levels.label: Adjective to Noun Suffixes
levels.translation: Ibiryayo by’ibiriya

examples.original: Her kindness made everyone feel welcome.
examples.phonetic: /hɜːr ˈkaɪndnəs meɪd ˈɛvrɪwʌn fiːl ˈwɛlkəm/
examples.translation: Ubwiza bwe bwari buzuye kuri buri wese.
examples.note: Ubwoko bw’ubwoko -ness: kind → kindness. Mu gihugu cy’Ubuspanieri bikorwa ‘-idad’ cyangwa ‘-ura’.

examples.original: The importance of education cannot be underestimated.
examples.phonetic: /ði ɪmˈpɔːrtəns əv ˌɛdʒuˈkeɪʃən kænɒt biː ˌʌndərˈɛstɪmeɪtɪd/
examples.translation: Ubwiza bwe bwari buzuye kuri buri wese.
examples.note: Ubwoko bw’ubwoko -ance kuri ibiriya by’ -ant: important → importance. Kanga ubwoba n’ ‘e’ ya mbere.

examples.original: She showed great strength in difficult times.
examples.phonetic: /ʃiː ʃoʊd ɡreɪt strɛŋkθ ɪn ˈdɪfɪkəlt taɪmz/
examples.translation: Yarabyaye ubwiza bwe mu gihe cy’ubwoba.
examples.note: Ubwoko bw’ubwoko -th: strong → strength. Ikibazo gihuye, ntukoreshe ‘-ness’.

levels.label: Nominalisation in Formal Register
levels.translation: Gutegura mu buryo bw’ubwoko bw’inyandiko z’akademi

examples.original: The implementation of the new policy was delayed.
examples.phonetic: /ði ˌɪmplɪmɛnˈteɪʃən əv ðə njuː ˈpɒləsi wɒz dɪˈleɪd/
examples.translation: Gutegura ubwenge bw’ubuki bw’ubuki byagezeho ubwiza bw’ubuki bw’ubuki.
examples.note: Mu gihugu cy’Angilere cy’ubwoko bw’inyandiko z’akademi bikorwa ‘implementation’ ahubwo ‘they implemented’.

examples.original: There has been an increase in unemployment.
examples.phonetic: /ðɛr hæz biːn ən ˈɪnkriːs ɪn ˌʌnɪmˈplɔɪmənt/
examples.translation: Hari ubwiza bw’ubuki bw’ubuki.
examples.note: Ubwoko bw’ubwoko n’ijambo ‘there has been’ + ubiranga. Ntukore ‘unemployment has increased’ mu buryo bw’ubwoko bw’inyandiko z’akademi.

examples.original: The failure of the talks led to conflict.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈfeɪljər əv ðə tɔːks lɛd tə ˈkɒnflɪkt/
examples.translation: Gutegura ubwenge bw’ubuki bw’ubuki byagezeho ubwiza bw’ubuki bw’ubuki.
examples.note: Ubwoko bw’ubwoko y’ikinyoma: fail → failure. Ntukore ‘the failing’.

title: Advanced Modal Verbs: Would Have, Should Have, etc. / Imirimo y’ibyo wahora yarakora: would have, should have, etc.
bridge: Mu gaciri, dusobanura ibyo tukoraho n’ubushakashatsi bw’umwanya (habría hecho, debería haber hecho) cyangwa n’ubushakashatsi bw’umwanya w’imperfecto. Ariko mu Icyongereza, imirimo y’ibyo wahora yarakora (would, should, could, might) ibirimo ‘have’ na participio y’imperfecto. Ububabare buhagije ni uko mu gaciri, dusaba ‘haber’ + participio, ariko mu Icyongereza, urutonde ni modal + 'have' + participio. Kwigomeka: 'would have' ntibitegekeye ‘habría tenido’ mu buryo bw’inyoma, ahubwo bishirira igikorwa cy’ubushakashatsi mu bishamye.
rule: Igihe kigaragara n’imirimo y’ibyo wahora yarakora (would, should, could, might, must) + 'have' + participio y’imperfecto. Igihe kigaragara kuri ibintu by’ubushakashatsi by’ubushakashatsi (would have), amahame yo kwigisha cyangwa ibyago (should have), ibikorwa bitari byo kwigeraho (could have, might have), na ibyago by’ubushakashatsi (must have). Mu by’ongera, ‘not’ bigaragara nyuma y’imirimo y’ibyo wahora yarakora (should not have / shouldn't have). Mu ibibazo, igisubizo kirimo umuntu (Would you have...?). Imirimo y’ubushakashatsi: would've, should've, could've. Ubwoko: 'must have' ntibigaragara kuri ibyo bitari byo kwigeraho (bigaragara 'couldn't have' cyangwa 'was not allowed to').

concept_examples.text: I would have called you, but I lost your number.
concept_examples.translation: Nzakubwiremu, ariko nashize numuburo wawe.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ wʊd hæv kɔːld juː bʌt aɪ lɔːst jɔːr ˈnʌmbər/

concept_examples.text: You should have studied more for the exam.
concept_examples.translation: Wowe ushaka kwiga neza kuri ikirango.
concept_examples.phonetic: /juː ʃʊd hæv ˈstʌdid mɔːr fɔːr ði ɪɡˈzæm/

concept_examples.text: She could have become a doctor, but she chose art.
concept_examples.translation: Yemwe yari ashatse kubana, ariko yishyize mu mashinga.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ʃiː kʊd hæv bɪˈkʌm ə ˈdɒktər bʌt ʃiː tʃuːz ɑːrt/

concept_examples.text: They must have missed the train; they're not here yet.
concept_examples.translation: Bishobora kuba bashize umutwe; ntibashoboye gutura.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðeɪ mʌst hæv mɪst ðə treɪn ðeər nɒt hɪər jet/

common_error.wrong: I would have called you, but I losed your number.
common_error.correct: I would have called you, but I lost your number.
common_error.correct_alt: I would have called you, but I had lost your number.
common_error.explanation: Ibikorwa by’ibyo bitari byo kwigeraho birasabwa n’ubushakashatsi bw’igaciri, aho ubushakashatsi bw’umwanya bw’imperfecto (perdí) bigaragara. Mu Icyongereza, nyuma y’ ‘would have’ bigaragara participio y’imperfecto (lost), igihe ntibigaragara ‘losed’. Noneka ko participio y’imperfecto ntibigaragara mu buryo bw’inyoma; noneka ko ubimenye ibyago by’ubushakashatsi. Uretse, noneka ko igisubizo kirimo umuntu kirimo participio, ntibigaragara mu buryo bw’umwanya w’imperfecto.

levels.label: Would have for hypothetical past
levels.translation: Would have kuri bishamye by’ubushakashatsi

examples.original: If I had known, I would have come earlier.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf aɪ hæd noʊn aɪ wʊd hæv kʌm ˈɜːrliər/
examples.translation: Nija kubishimo, nzakubwira.
examples.note: Noneka ubushakashatsi bw’umwanya w’imperfecto mu buryo bw’ubushakashatsi (‘had known’) na ‘would have’ mu buryo bw’ubushakashatsi.

examples.original: We would have won the game if the referee hadn't made that mistake.
examples.phonetic: /wiː wʊd hæv wʌn ðə ɡeɪm ɪf ðə ˌrefəˈriː ˈhædənt meɪd ðæt mɪˈsteɪk/
examples.translation: Twarashoboye gutura igitero, igikorwa cy’umukono nticyari gikorwa neza.
examples.note: Mu buryo bw’ubushakashatsi, ‘hadn’t’ bigaragara mu buryo bw’ubushakashatsi na ‘wouldn’t have’ bigaragara mu buryo bw’ubushakashatsi.

examples.original: I wouldn't have said that if I were you.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ ˈwʊdənt hæv sed ðæt ɪf aɪ wɜːr juː/
examples.translation: Nta n’ubwo nzakubwira ibyo, nija kuba wowe.
examples.note: Ubushakashatsi ntibugaragara mu buryo bw’igaciri; mu Icyongereza, ‘wouldn’t have + participio’ bigaragara.

levels.label: Should have and Could have for criticism or missed opportunities
levels.translation: Should have na could have kuri ibyago cyangwa ibikorwa bitari byo kwigeraho

examples.original: You should have told me about the meeting.
examples.phonetic: /juː ʃʊd hæv toʊld miː əˈbaʊt ðə ˈmiːtɪŋ/
examples.translation: Wowe ushaka kwigisha neza kuri ikirango.
examples.note: ‘Should have’ bigaragara kuri ibyago cyangwa ibyago by’ubushakashatsi.

examples.original: He could have asked for help, but he didn't.
examples.phonetic: /hiː kʊd hæv æskt fɔːr hɛlp bʌt hiː ˈdɪdnt/
examples.translation: Yemwe yari ashatse gusaba umwete, ariko ntishyize.
examples.note: ‘Could have’ bishirira ibikorwa bitari byo kwigeraho.

examples.original: She shouldn't have quit her job so quickly.
examples.phonetic: /ʃiː ˈʃʊdənt hæv kwɪt hɜːr dʒɒb soʊ ˈkwɪkli/
examples.translation: Ntishaka kuba yishyize mu mashinga.
examples.note: ‘Shouldn’t have’ bigaragara kuri ibyago by’ubushakashatsi.

levels.label: Might have and Must have for possibility and deduction
levels.translation: Might have na must have kuri ibikorwa na ibyago

examples.original: The keys might have fallen out of your pocket.
examples.phonetic: /ðə kiːz maɪt hæv ˈfɔːlən aʊt əv jɔːr ˈpɒkɪt/
examples.translation: Imitotsi yawe yashoboye kuba yarashize mu gacumu wawe.
examples.note: ‘Might have’ bishirira ibikorwa, ntibyago.

examples.original: She must have been very tired after the trip.
examples.phonetic: /ʃiː mʌst hæv bɪn ˈveri ˈtaɪərd ˈɑːftər ðə trɪp/
examples.translation: Yemwe yari ashatse kwishyura neza nyuma y’urugendo.
examples.note: ‘Must have’ bishirira ibyago by’ubushakashatsi.

examples.original: They couldn't have known about the party.
examples.phonetic: /ðeɪ ˈkʊdnt hæv noʊn əˈbaʊt ðə ˈpɑːrti/
examples.translation: Ntibashoboye kubona ibintu by’umukino.
examples.note: Kuri ibyago by’ubushakashatsi, ‘couldn’t have’ bigaragara ahandi ‘mustn’t have’.

translations.rw: Imirimo y’ibyo wahora yarakora: would have, should have, etc.
